signal: Team D3 was acquired by Addnode Group and is now Symetri, Autodesk's largest global partner serving 25,000+ customers across merged Microdesk and Team D3 teams.

email.body1:
Marian, saw Team D3 is now part of Symetri, Autodesk's largest global partner after merging with Microdesk.

Stitching three sales orgs together usually means signals pile up faster than ops can route them to action, and good accounts go cold in the gap. Our AI SDR turns a signal into a researched, personalized, logged touch with zero rep time: 3-5x more meetings per rep, same team.

I built a personalized signal play for Symetri off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Marian, quick follow-up for Symetri.

Post-merger, the biggest measurable leak is usually time between a signal firing and a rep acting on it, plus the data hygiene work that eats ops cycles. Tightening that is where lift hides: our best practices alone tend to raise reply rates 50 to 70 percent.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I'd change to cut that latency across the combined team.
email.body3:
Marian, last bit of proof for Symetri.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M dollars in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Symetri's reply rate likely compares to other Autodesk-ecosystem partners. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Marian, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount isn't a priority while the Symetri integration settles, no problem at all. Timing matters most mid-merger, and I know that stretch keeps ops underwater.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I'll tailor it to Symetri either way.
